entries.subject: Size: JPL Small-Body Database diameter
entries.finding: 884 Priamus is drawn as a sphere at the 101.093 ± 0.539 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists, with JPL's stated reference urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[jupiter_trojans] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759...49G). DAMIT held no shape model for it on 2026-10-08, so the sphere is illustrative.

entries.subject: Priamus whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 20 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.898 at 462 nm, 1.024 at 638 nm). The sphere is painted in that one color (#3d3b37 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.4% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.2%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
